name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
plainEligibility: Rural youth from poor households, generally aged 15–35, can seek placement-linked skill training.
benefits: Skill training, placement support, and post-placement support through approved training partners.
documents: Education certificates, if required for the job role
applicationMode: Apply through an approved DDU-GKY training centre or state rural-skills mission.
notesFlags: Official NCS describes DDU-GKY as focused on rural youth aged 15–35 from poor families.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 — Short-Term Training
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
plainEligibility: Indian nationals aged 15–45 with a valid Aadhaar who want fresh skilling, reskilling, or upskilling can select an eligible job role.
benefits: Free NSQF-aligned training of generally 300–600 hours, on-the-job training, assessment, certification, accidental insurance, and access to jobs or apprenticeships.
documents: Prior qualification proof for the selected job role
applicationMode: Register on Skill India Digital and choose a nearby eligible training centre.
applicationWindow: Check Skill India Digital for active batches.
notesFlags: myScheme lists free 300–600 hour training, OJT, certification, and 15–45 eligibility; confirm the live course and centre before enrolment.

name: Pradhan Mantri National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (PM-NAPS)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
plainEligibility: Young people can apply for registered apprenticeship opportunities that match the establishment and trade requirements.
benefits: Workplace apprenticeship and government support toward the apprentice stipend, up to the limit in the current notification.
applicationMode: Register and search vacancies on the Apprenticeship India portal.
notesFlags: PMIndia describes PM-NAPS as a Skill India component and states central DBT support of 25% of stipend up to ₹1,500 per month, subject to scheme rules.

name: National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS)
ministry: Ministry of Education
plainEligibility: Technically qualified graduates, diploma holders, and vocational candidates can seek practical workplace training when they meet the establishment’s criteria.
benefits: One year of practical training and a Certificate of Proficiency after successful completion.
applicationMode: Register on the NATS portal and apply to advertised apprenticeship seats.
notesFlags: Official NCS describes NATS as a one-year programme for technically qualified youth.

name: Jan Shikshan Sansthan (JSS)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
plainEligibility: Women, rural youth, and economically disadvantaged people aged about 15–45 can seek nearby community-based vocational training.
benefits: Low-cost or supported doorstep vocational training, certification, and pathways to self-employment or wage work.
documents: Category or vulnerability proof where applicable
applicationMode: Enquire through a local JSS centre or Skill India Digital listing.
notesFlags: PMIndia describes JSS as community-centric and focused on women, rural youth, and economically disadvantaged groups aged 15–45.

name: Rural Self Employment Training Institutes (RSETI)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
plainEligibility: Rural youth, especially from low-income households, can seek entrepreneurship and self-employment training through district RSETIs.
benefits: Short-duration entrepreneurship training, handholding, and support toward starting a micro-enterprise.
applicationMode: Contact the district RSETI or its implementing bank.
notesFlags: Official NCS describes RSETI as district-level infrastructure for rural BPL youth entrepreneurship training.

name: National Career Service (NCS)
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
plainEligibility: Jobseekers can create a profile and search vacancies, counselling, career, and employment services.
benefits: Free access to job search, career counselling, job fairs, and links to government employment services.
applicationMode: Register on the National Career Service portal.
notesFlags: NCS also exposes filters for government jobs, jobs for women, jobs for persons with disabilities, and ex-servicemen.

name: Skill India Digital Hub
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
plainEligibility: Learners can create a verified profile and discover eligible courses, training centres, apprenticeships, and employment pathways.
benefits: Digital discovery, counselling, course enrolment, certification records, and access to jobs or apprenticeship opportunities.
documents: Bank details where a benefit requires them
applicationMode: Create a profile on Skill India Digital.
notesFlags: The PMIndia Skill India Programme update identifies Skill India Digital as the current digital access route.

name: PM Vishwakarma — Skill Development Component
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
plainEligibility: Eligible traditional artisans and craftspeople can seek recognition, skill training, and enterprise support under PM Vishwakarma.
benefits: Basic and advanced skill training, toolkit incentive, digital transaction incentive, and credit-linked enterprise support under scheme rules.
documents: Gram Panchayat or urban local body verification
applicationMode: Apply through the official PM Vishwakarma registration route or assisted centre.
notesFlags: Confirm trade eligibility and current incentive amounts on the official portal before applying.

name: Prime Minister’s Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
plainEligibility: Individuals and eligible groups can seek support for setting up new micro-enterprises when they meet PMEGP conditions.
benefits: Margin-money subsidy linked to an approved project and bank finance, with entrepreneurship training requirements.
documents: Category or special-group certificate where applicable
applicationMode: Submit an online PMEGP application for bank and implementing-agency appraisal.
notesFlags: This is an enterprise route; loan sanction and project viability remain part of the decision.

name: DAY-NULM — Employment through Skills Training and Placement
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
plainEligibility: Urban poor residents can seek skill training and placement support through city livelihood missions.
benefits: Skill training, certification, and placement assistance through approved urban livelihood centres.
documents: Urban-poor or vulnerability proof where required
applicationMode: Contact the Urban Local Body or City Mission Manager.
notesFlags: Confirm city-level availability and current course list with the ULB.

name: Seekho aur Kamao (Learn & Earn)
ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs
plainEligibility: Youth from notified minority communities can seek market-oriented skill training when they meet the current implementing agency conditions.
benefits: Skill training in traditional and modern trades with pathways to wage employment or self-employment.
applicationMode: Follow current Ministry or implementing-agency notices.
notesFlags: The official NCS page identifies Seekho aur Kamao as a minority skill-development route; verify the active notice.

name: Nai Manzil
ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs
plainEligibility: Eligible minority youth who need education equivalency and livelihood skills can seek support under the active programme route.
benefits: Education bridge support, skills training, and livelihood or placement assistance where available.
applicationMode: Check current Ministry or implementing-agency enrolment notices.
notesFlags: Confirm current operational status and implementing partner before presenting a live batch.

name: USTTAD — Upgrading the Skills and Training in Traditional Arts/Crafts
ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs
plainEligibility: Traditional artisans from notified minority communities can seek design, training, and market linkage support.
benefits: Upgrading of traditional skills, entrepreneurship support, and market or exhibition linkage.
applicationMode: Follow the current Ministry implementation notice.
notesFlags: Verify current implementing partners and intake dates.

name: Green Skill Development Programme
ministry: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
plainEligibility: Learners and workers can seek environment and forest-sector skill training through approved programme centres.
benefits: Green-skills training and certification for work related to ecosystems, biodiversity, energy, and waste reduction.
applicationMode: Check the programme or partner training-centre notice.
notesFlags: Official NCS describes green skills as supporting environmental and forest-sector employment.

name: Skill Loan Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Finance
plainEligibility: Youth seeking an eligible skill-development course can explore institutional credit through participating lenders.
benefits: Education-style loan finance for eligible skill-development courses, subject to lender appraisal and current scheme terms.
documents: Co-borrower and bank documents as required
applicationMode: Apply through a participating lender or the current JanSamarth route.
applicationWindow: Year-round, subject to lender and course availability.
notesFlags: The myScheme page was unavailable during research; confirm current lender terms and eligibility before applying.

name: Employment Linked Skill Training Programme (ELSTP)
ministry: State skill-development implementation route
plainEligibility: Eligible learners can seek demand-driven training linked to employment in sectors such as IT, healthcare, agriculture, and electronics.
benefits: Skill training, assessment, and employment linkage under the active state or implementing-agency programme.
applicationMode: Follow the live myScheme application route or implementing-agency instructions.
notesFlags: Confirm the implementing state and current intake before application.

name: Skill Development in ESDM for Digital India
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
plainEligibility: Students and learners meeting the current course or training-centre requirements can seek electronics-system-design and manufacturing skills.
benefits: Training and certification in ESDM-related skills, with a stated programme target of 3,28,000 candidates in the myScheme record.
applicationMode: Apply through the listed training or implementing route.
notesFlags: Confirm current course availability and intake.

name: Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) Training Programme
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
plainEligibility: Workers with existing skills can seek assessment and certification against an approved occupational standard.
benefits: Recognition, assessment, certification, and possible bridge training for prior skills.
documents: Work or skill evidence where requested
applicationMode: Find an active RPL or Skill India training centre.
notesFlags: Course duration and trade eligibility vary by active batch.

name: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
plainEligibility: Eligible members of notified disadvantaged communities can seek training and livelihood support under active PM-DAKSH courses.
benefits: Short-term training, upskilling, reskilling, and entrepreneurship-oriented support through approved centres.
applicationMode: Register through PM-DAKSH or a listed training centre.
notesFlags: Confirm current course eligibility and intake on the portal.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
plainEligibility: Rural households whose adult members volunteer for unskilled manual work can request employment through the local Gram Panchayat.
benefits: Demand-driven wage employment, generally up to the household entitlement under the Act and current state schedule of rates.
applicationMode: Request a job card and work through the Gram Panchayat or programme office.
notesFlags: Wage rates, work availability, and payment timing vary by state and current notification.

name: National Urban Livelihoods Mission — Self Employment Programme
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
plainEligibility: Urban poor individuals or groups can seek support for self-employment projects through the city livelihood mission.
benefits: Skill support, enterprise promotion, and credit-linked or interest-subsidy support subject to current mission guidelines.
documents: Group or SHG records where applicable
applicationMode: Contact the Urban Local Body or city mission office.
notesFlags: Confirm current city-level operational route and financing terms.

name: National Skill Development Mission
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
plainEligibility: Learners can use the national skilling ecosystem to discover approved courses, centres, assessments, and employment pathways.
benefits: Convergence of skill training, assessment, certification, apprenticeship, and employment services.
applicationMode: Use Skill India Digital and linked government training routes.
notesFlags: This is an ecosystem route; the exact benefit depends on the selected component.

name: Financial Assistance for Skill Training of Persons with Disabilities
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
plainEligibility: Persons with disabilities can seek supported skill training through notified centres when they meet the active course conditions.
benefits: Training, stipendiary support in notified programmes, assessment, and certification for employability.
applicationMode: Check NCS and notified training-centre intake.
notesFlags: Official NCS lists this route for persons with disabilities and states that stipendiary support is provided in notified training programmes.

name: Skill Development for Minorities — Livelihood Training Route
ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs
plainEligibility: Eligible minority youth can seek non-traditional or market-linked skill training for employment or self-employment.
benefits: Skill upgrading, certification, and pathways to employment or enterprise under the active implementing scheme.
applicationMode: Follow the Ministry’s current notice or an approved training partner.
notesFlags: Use the current Ministry notice to confirm the active scheme name, partner, and intake.
